name: LayerX
description: Tokyo-based software company whose Bakuraku platform automates invoice processing, expense claims and corporate card spending for Japanese businesses; raised a $100 million Series B in 2025.

name: Tokio Marine
description: Japanese insurance group selling property, casualty, life and specialty insurance to individuals and businesses, with operations in more than 40 countries and regions; listed in Tokyo.

name: Lumentum
description: Designs and makes optical and photonic products, including lasers and transceiver components, for cloud, AI data center, telecom networking and industrial customers; listed on Nasdaq (LITE).

name: Holtec International
description: Privately held nuclear technology company that makes spent fuel storage casks and heat transfer equipment, decommissions shut nuclear plants and is developing the SMR-300 reactor for utilities worldwide.

name: JetZero
description: Long Beach startup developing the Z4, a 250-seat blended wing body airliner for commercial airlines, and building a full-scale demonstrator under a $235 million US Air Force contract.

name: Penguin Solutions
description: Nasdaq-listed company that designs, builds and manages high-performance computing and AI infrastructure for enterprises and governments, and also sells specialty memory products, with about $1.4 billion annual revenue.
note: Renamed from SGH (SMART Global Holdings) to Penguin Solutions in October 2024.

name: Mitsui & Co
description: Japanese general trading company that trades and invests in metals, energy, chemicals, machinery, infrastructure and food for businesses worldwide, with about 125 offices in 61 countries.

name: Southern California Edison
description: Edison International's regulated electric utility, supplying power to homes and businesses serving about 15 million people across a 50,000-square-mile area of central, coastal and southern California.

name: Kinetic
description: Little Rock-based home internet brand of Uniti Group, formerly Windstream's consumer business, selling fiber and DSL broadband to households and small businesses in mostly rural US markets.
note: Parent Windstream merged with Uniti Group in 2025; Kinetic is now Uniti's consumer brand.

name: Alinma Bank
description: Saudi Shariah-compliant bank offering retail, corporate, treasury and investment services to individuals and businesses, listed on Tadawul since 2008, with about 108 branches across the Kingdom.

name: Palmetto
description: Charlotte-based clean energy company whose LightReach plans lease rooftop solar and batteries to US homeowners with no upfront cost, sold through more than 600 installer partners in 30 states.

name: LS Cable & System
description: South Korean maker of power and telecom cables, including high-voltage submarine and underground transmission cables, for utilities, grid operators and offshore wind projects worldwide; part of LS Group.

name: Verisure Securitas Direct
description: Sells professionally monitored alarm systems to households and small businesses in 17 countries across Europe and Latin America, serving about 5.8 million customers; listed in Stockholm since 2025.

name: Divergent
description: Uses AI-driven design, metal 3D printing and robotic assembly to make vehicle and aerospace structures for automakers and defense contractors; valued at $2.3 billion in a 2025 funding round.

name: Navitas Semiconductor
description: Fabless chip company designing gallium nitride and silicon carbide power semiconductors for AI data centers, electric vehicles, solar inverters and mobile fast chargers; listed on Nasdaq (NVTS).

name: Jazz Pharmaceuticals
description: Dublin-based biopharmaceutical company selling medicines for sleep disorders, epilepsy and cancer, such as Xywav and Epidiolex, to healthcare markets in the US and abroad; Nasdaq-listed with about 2,800 employees.

name: Estee Lauder Companies
description: New York-based maker of prestige skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care brands, including Clinique, MAC and La Mer, sold through retailers and online in about 150 countries; NYSE-listed.

name: SharpLink
description: Nasdaq-listed company that holds ether as its main treasury reserve asset, more than 800,000 ETH by 2026, and runs an online casino and sports betting affiliate marketing business.

name: Neolix
description: Beijing-based developer of autonomous delivery vans for logistics, parcel and retail operators, with more than 16,000 vehicles deployed in 15 countries, including China and the UAE.

name: Dubai Islamic Bank
description: UAE's largest Islamic bank by assets, offering Shariah-compliant retail, corporate and investment banking to individuals and businesses through about 90 UAE branches; listed on the Dubai Financial Market.

name: Coca-Cola HB
description: Coca-Cola bottler that produces, sells and distributes Coca-Cola and other drinks to retailers and restaurants in 29 countries on three continents; listed in London and part of the FTSE 100.

name: Massed Come
description: GPU cloud provider renting NVIDIA GPU instances, bare-metal servers and multi-node clusters to AI developers, researchers and companies for training, rendering and HPC work; NVIDIA Preferred Partner founded in 2021.

name: Corsair
description: Milpitas-based maker of PC components and gaming peripherals, including memory, power supplies, keyboards, Elgato streaming gear and SCUF controllers, for gamers and creators; Nasdaq-listed with about $1.3 billion revenue.

name: Alaska Airlines
description: Seattle-based US airline carrying passengers and cargo to about 128 destinations, mainly on the West Coast and to Alaska and Hawaii, with roughly 350 aircraft; owned by Alaska Air Group.
note: Parent Alaska Air Group completed its acquisition of Hawaiian Airlines in September 2024.

name: Colovore
description: Colocation provider offering liquid-cooled, high-density data center space, up to 600 kW per rack, to enterprises running AI workloads, with sites in Silicon Valley, Reno, Chicago, Austin and Dallas.

name: PDD Holdings
description: Owns China's Pinduoduo shopping platform and the Temu international marketplace, selling low-priced goods online to consumers; Nasdaq-listed, headquartered in Dublin, with about $54 billion revenue in 2024.

name: Turk Eximbank
correct_name: Turk Eximbank (Export Credit Bank of Turkiye)
description: Turkey's state-owned export credit agency, based in Istanbul, providing export loans, guarantees and export credit insurance to Turkish exporters, overseas contractors and foreign buyers of Turkish goods.

name: wefox
description: Insurance distribution platform and managing general agent selling policies through brokers, agents and online to retail customers in Austria, the Netherlands and Switzerland, with over 1 million customers served.
note: Website now lists only Austria, the Netherlands and Switzerland; check recent news on unit sales or restructuring before outreach.

name: Grab
description: Singapore-based super-app offering ride-hailing, food and grocery delivery, digital payments and banking to consumers, drivers and merchants in eight Southeast Asian countries; Nasdaq-listed with about 11,000 employees.

name: Duetti
description: New York-based music company that buys and manages recording and publishing rights from independent artists, songwriters and producers, with offices in seven cities and over $635 million raised.

name: Kennedy Wilson
description: Beverly Hills-based real estate investment company that invests in and manages property for itself and institutional investors in the US, UK and Ireland, with about $28 billion under management.
note: February 2026: agreed to a roughly $1.5 billion take-private by a CEO-led consortium including Fairfax Financial; NYSE listing (KW) ends when it closes.

name: LendingPoint
description: Kennesaw, Georgia-based online lender using AI-driven credit models to offer personal loans of $1,000 to $36,500 and point-of-sale financing to US consumers often turned away by traditional scoring.

name: Colossal Biosciences
description: Dallas-based genetic engineering company developing de-extinction and conservation technologies, including woolly mammoth and dire wolf projects, with wildlife agencies and research partners; valued at $10.2 billion in 2025.

name: Mojo Vision
description: Cupertino-based developer of micro-LED display technology built on 300mm silicon wafers for AI glasses and optical interconnect makers, backed by venture investors and $24.4 million in US defense funding.

name: Telegram
description: Dubai-based cloud messaging app and social platform used by more than 1 billion monthly users worldwide, earning revenue from Premium subscriptions, in-app purchases and advertising in public channels.

name: Vinfast
description: Vingroup's Vietnamese electric vehicle maker, selling cars, scooters and buses to consumers and fleets in Asia, North America, Europe and the Middle East; Nasdaq-listed, about 197,000 car sales in 2025.
note: May 2026: announced sale of its Vietnamese manufacturing arm (about US$530 million) and shift to an asset-light model; US plant delayed to 2028.

name: Lucid Motors
description: Newark, California-based maker of luxury electric vehicles, the Air sedan and Gravity SUV, sold mainly in the US and Saudi Arabia; Nasdaq-listed and majority owned by Saudi Arabia's PIF.

name: Medline Industries
description: Northfield, Illinois-based maker and distributor of medical and surgical supplies for hospitals, nursing homes, surgery centers and clinics in over 125 countries; about 45,000 employees, Nasdaq-listed since December 2025.

name: Alimentation Couche-Tard
description: Laval, Quebec-based operator of about 17,000 convenience stores and fuel stations, mainly under the Circle K brand, serving consumers in about 27 countries; listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

name: Ziraat bank
description: Turkish public bank founded in 1863 and owned by the Turkey Wealth Fund, lending to companies, farmers, tradesmen and households through more than 1,700 branches plus subsidiaries in several countries.

name: Aureus Capital
note: could not identify (no New York finance firm by this name confirmed; web search budget ran out before a second lookup)

name: Hertz
description: Estero, Florida-based car rental company operating the Hertz, Dollar and Thrifty brands for leisure and business travelers at about 12,000 locations in 160 countries; Nasdaq-listed.
note: Filed Chapter 11 in May 2020; emerged July 2021 and relisted on Nasdaq in November 2021.

name: CEGID
description: Lyon-based provider of cloud software for finance, accounting, tax, payroll, HR and retail, sold to companies, accounting firms and retailers in about 130 countries; about EUR 1.07 billion 2025 revenue.

name: Compass Datacenters
description: Dallas-based company that designs, builds and operates large data center campuses for hyperscale cloud and AI customers, with about 17 US campuses plus sites in Canada and Israel.
note: Owned since 2023 by Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan and Brookfield Infrastructure.

name: TenneT Germany
description: One of Germany's four high-voltage transmission grid operators, running the power grid across much of the country for distribution networks, generators and industry; co-owned by TenneT, Germany and private investors.
note: 46% sold to an investor consortium for EUR 9.5bn (Sept 2025); German government bought 25.1% (Feb 2026); TenneT holding keeps 28.9%.

name: Hyperscale Data
description: Las Vegas-based holding company offering AI data center colocation, hosting, managed and cloud services, and holding bitcoin as a treasury reserve asset; listed on NYSE American (GPUS).

name: Abivax
description: Paris-based clinical-stage biotech developing obefazimod, an oral drug for ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease patients; listed on Euronext Paris and Nasdaq, raising $920 million in a 2026 share offering.

name: BrainCo
description: Brain-computer interface company making EEG headbands for focus and sleep and neural-controlled prosthetic hands for consumers and amputees; based in Hangzhou, raised about $280 million in January 2026.
note: Filed confidentially for a Hong Kong IPO in January 2026; headquarters moved from Somerville, MA to Hangzhou in 2018.

name: Unimicron Technology
description: Taiwanese maker of printed circuit boards, HDI and flexible boards and IC substrates for chip and electronics makers, with plants in Taiwan, China, Germany and Japan; listed in Taiwan.

name: Wayve
description: London-based developer of camera-based AI driving software for automakers and mobility firms such as Nissan, Uber and Stellantis; about 1,000 staff and a $1.2 billion Series D in 2026.
